sentence: This project builds a software-based tool that enables health applications and medical devices to detect health-related features in a person's voice.
This project studies how soil microorganisms affect carbon dioxide emission across biomes and climates, using field measurements and mathematical models of microbial growth.
This project studies how to recognize individuals by fingerprints, face, iris, voice and gait, and how to improve the security of biometric recognition systems.
This project builds design methods that improve the power, performance, reliability and cost of AI hardware made from stacked chiplets.
This project studies how DNA methylation changes as a meiofaunal annelid develops and how it relates to shifts in the timing of development.
This project studies how two proteins work together to make centrosomes separate properly during cell division in a microscopic nematode worm.
This project explores how robots and AI can learn from human behavior and preferences and provide useful services in the home.
This project builds a platform that uses thermal and acoustic fields to guide droplets into place and build 3D photonic structures.
This project builds methods that perform anomaly detection on data such as network traffic and system logs while keeping the data private.
This project studies how global optimization algorithms behave by modeling them as dynamical systems, and uses what it learns to tune solvers automatically.
This project builds a generative simulation that lets robots learn to make safe physical contact with people.
This project studies imaging devices, additively manufactured implants and other medical devices with attention to ethics, law and policies.
This project tests whether the feces of coral-eating fish help corals in early life stages acquire symbionts and recover from heat stress.
This project measures the amount of sulfur-based binding sites for metals in water and sediment samples, using mass spectrometry.
This project builds a robotic system that places needles precisely during image-guided procedures using imaging feedback and closed-loop control.
